d:
A new version of my old gallery for Aggie Prenderghast. I've wanted to update the old gallery for like a year, but couldn't. Aggie is one of my favorite girls and a highly underrated character. She's a cute little ghost who's perfect for lewding!

Includes art from Simon, Pears, VSDrawfag, ChromosomeFarm and Smeet.

Warning: Lolicon/Shota.
